programme.title: Disturbing Behavior
programme.desc: Newcomer Steve (James Marsden) is cautioned by Gavin Strick (Nick Stahl) about the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic, perfect students who rule the school. When Gavin turns into a "perfect" himself, Steve and Rachel Wagner (Katie Holmes) investigate.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An rookie FBI agent goes up against a brutal serial killer...and a cannibalistic psychiatrist.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Hannibal Lecter comes out of hiding to draw Agent Clarice Starling into a high-stakes battle.

programme.title: Species
programme.desc: When a beautiful alien hybrid (Natasha Henstridge) escapes from his lab, a scientist (Ben Kingsley) hires a team of experts to find her before she is able to mate and produce offspring. It’s a desperate battle and the fate of humanity is at stake!

programme.title: Species II
programme.desc: When an astronaut morphs into an alien entity, impregnating women with deadly results, a clone of Eve (Natasha Henstridge) is sent to hunt him down. But they underestimate Eve’s maternal drive…and now only the strongest species will survive!

programme.title: Lifeforce
programme.desc: Steve Railsback stars in this frightening journey into the unknown as a mission to investigate Halley's Comet discovers an alien craft whose seductive leader begins a terrifying campaign to drain the lifeforce of everyone she encounters!

programme.title: The Incredible Melting Man
programme.desc: Colonel West returns from an historic trip to Saturn with a strange ailment: his flesh is melting! And only human flesh and blood will keep him alive!

programme.title: The Quatermass Xperiment
programme.desc: The streets of London are transformed into a smorgasbord for an alien creature with a taste for human flesh. Don't just panic…run for your lives!

programme.title: The Black Sleep
programme.desc: Basil Rathbone, Bela Lugosi, Lon Chaney, Jr. and John Carradine star in this terrifying horror classic about a brain surgeon's unorthodox experiments.

programme.title: Donovan's Brain
programme.desc: Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its own�and is controlling him through telepathic messages!

programme.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

programme.title: Tentacles
programme.desc: It's angry, hungry, well-armed and ready to sample the local cuisine! John Huston, Shelley Winters and Henry Fonda star in this gripping thriller!

programme.title: Night Of The Comet
programme.desc: In this cult-classic zom-com, two totally awesome Valley Girls (Catherine Mary Stewart, Kelli Maroney) kick some zombie butt and go on the lam from bloodthirsty scientists after a passing comet turns all of Los Angeles into the walking undead!

programme.title: Monkey Shines: An Experiment In Fear
programme.desc: In this classic spine-tingler, a paralyzed man (Jason Beghe) is cared for by Ella, an intelligent monkey. But when Ella seems to begin reading Allan's darker thoughts, he must stop the cunning maniacal creature...before she takes over his mind!

programme.title: The Believers
programme.desc: Widowed police psychologist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic child murders perpetrated by a rogue cult.

programme.title: Clive Barker's Lord Of Illusions
programme.desc: Scott Bakula stars as a detective who gets more than he bargains for in this thriller that rips apart the boundaries between the illusion and magic.

programme.title: From Beyond
programme.desc: Humans are such easy prey! H.P. Lovecraft's classic tale of suspense becomes "a grisly amalgam of sex, shock and satire" (Newsweek) in the hands of the creators of "Re-Animator." Jeffrey Combs and Barbara Crampton star in this cult-classic!

programme.title: The Curse
programme.desc: When a ice-blue meteor plunges through the sky and lands on a dairy farm, every living thing is infected and the farm owners change…hideously!

programme.title: Die, Monster, Die!
programme.desc: An English scientist entertains a young American visitor, serving up tea, terror and a beautiful daughter who is soon torn between her father's evil ways and protecting the man she loves. Boris Karloff stars in this H.P. Lovecraft adaptation.

programme.title: The Dunwich Horror
programme.desc: When a beautiful student named Nancy Wagner (Sandra Dee) catches the eye of the weird Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell), her professor uncovers a buried secret and a plot intended to call forth an evil beyond imagination. Daniel Haller directs.

programme.title: Murders In The Rue Morgue
programme.desc: In Paris, a theatrical company with a specialty in Grand Guignol undertakes their most gruesome production yet! And the blood will flow!

programme.title: The Hound Of The Baskervilles (1959)
programme.desc: A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

programme.title: The Last Man On Earth
programme.desc: Horror legend Vincent Price plays the sole survivor of a plague that turns humans into vampire-like zombies...and his life into an endless nightmare!

programme.title: The Comedy Of Terrors
programme.desc: Facing a mound of debt, an devious undertaker and his reluctant assistant devise a wickedly funny plan to make death pay...by creating customers!

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African American horror film.

programme.title: Scream, Blacula, Scream!
programme.desc: Brought back to the world of the living by a voodoo ceremony Blacula (William Marshall) is loosed with insatiable bloodlust upon the population of a small community in the Louisiana back country. Pam Grier also stars in this scintillating sequel

programme.title: Sugar Hill
programme.desc: When a nightclub entrepreneur gets taken out by the mob, his girlfriend calls upon a voodoo high priest to carry out an unholy plan for revenge.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll attempts to forever erase mankind, a sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his plan.

programme.title: Troll 2
programme.desc: Disguised as friendly country folk, a posse of people-eating trolls lures visitors to their town, and a family of four is about to discover this place is a real tourist trap. Now, the no-good gnomes must be destroyed before the family gets flambed.

programme.title: Reptilicus
programme.desc: Discover the true meaning of survival of the fittest as a terrifying creature from the past brings the future to its knees in this Danish-American kaiju creature feature about a cold-blooded 90-foot killer whose time has come... again!

programme.title: Yongary: Monster From The Deep
programme.desc: In South Korea's first entry into the kaiju genre, a monstrous creature creates destruction throughout Korea as scientists race against time to create a refrigerant that may be the only weapon to stop the monster before it destroys the country!

programme.title: Leviathan
programme.desc: In this sci-fi thriller, Peter Weller leads an exploration team trapped five miles beneath the ocean's surface with a creature that cannot die!

programme.title: Ghoulies
programme.desc: It's the horrifying and hilarious ride into the darkest regions of hell that started it all! When Jonathan (Peter Liapis) inherits his late father's home and finds a book of spells, he unlocks unimaginable demonic horrors!

programme.title: Ghoulies II
programme.desc: The Ghoulies are back and more devilish than ever as they turn an unsuspecting carnival into a house of pandemonium in this wildly outrageous sequel to the smash hit "Ghoulies!" Damon Martin and Royal Dano star in this cult-classic!

programme.title: Howling II: Your Sister Is A Werewolf
programme.desc: In this cult-classic sequel, when the brother of doomed newscaster Karen White, her co-worker and a mysterious stranger (Christopher Lee) set out to save the world from a werewolf invasion, they must first destroy an immortal werewolf queen!

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Most moms are wonderful cooks, this one...likes it raw! Something's been eating Clay Dwyer. His mom! Once a sweet lovable lady, she's been bitten by and transformed into a flesheater, turning her into a hungry creature with a knack for good old homestyle cooking. What is Clay to do? To everyone else she's a monster that must be destroyed. But to him she's still MOM.

programme.title: Blood And Chocolate
programme.desc: A young teenage werewolf (Bruckner) is torn between honoring her family's secret and her love for a man (Dancy).

programme.title: The Initiation Of Sarah
programme.desc: In this cult-classic thriller, Kay Lenz and Shelley Winters star as a co-ed and the witchy head of a sorority who has special plans for the new girl.

programme.title: Dead Of Winter
programme.desc: Struggling actress Mary Steenburgen is offered the film role of a lifetime by the mysterious Roddy McDowall. But all is not as it seems and, as the pieces fall into place, her quest for stardom becomes a fight for survival in this twisty thriller.

programme.title: Lady In White
programme.desc: When a nine-year-old boy sees the ghost of a girl being murdered, he bravely sets out to solve the crime, but the killer may be closer than he knows!

programme.title: The Dark Half
programme.desc: When a horror novelist tries to "kill off" his successful author pseudonym, he finds his alter ego on a greusome quest for revenge.
